object.attr: derived: agents built against 0.3.0 give no commit, so such a key is accepted with a warning for one release; MELLON-TRACE-SRS-149 then replaces this requirement (CF-T31). Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: If an ack_suspects link key gives no commit, the MCP server shall acknowledge the link and warn that the key gives no reviewed commit.
